decisive_items: Brain Biopsy (left frontal lesion): CD5− CD10− CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER−
Cerebrospinal fluid: Presence of lymphoma cells
response.rationale: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results strongly support the diagnosis of Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma

rejected.why: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results contradict the diagnosis of Multiple Sclerosis
The brain biopsy results do not support the diagnosis of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy
